title: Fused Azine Derivatives Mitigate Long-Term Paracetamol-Induced Liver Fibrosis in Mice: Role of JNK1/ASK1 and Nrf2/HO-1 Signaling Pathways.
authors: Shawky, Ahmed Reda; Metwaly, Heba A; Ragab, Hanan M; Wahid, Ahmed
one_liner_zh: 该文研究融合吖嗪衍生物对扑热息痛诱导小鼠肝纤维化的保护作用及JNK1/ASK1和Nrf2/HO-1信号通路机制，仅涉及小分子-蛋白对接，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Liver fibrosis is a significant public health issue that necessitates an ongoing urge for efficient novel treatments. Our newly synthesized fused azine derivative compounds (1a, 1b, 2a, and 2b) were used in this study based on our promising results achieved by our team in previous studies on tacrine derivatives. This study investigated these compounds' hepatoprotective effect on mice with paracetamol (APAP) induced liver fibrosis and clarified their possible mechanisms. The administration of these compounds successfully reduced APAP-induced hepatic fibrosis through decreasing serum liver enzymes, as well as the hepatic pathological deterioration. Moreover, they increased hepatic antioxidants and countered oxidative stress caused by APAP. Furthermore, by lowering inflammatory cytokine levels and raising anti-inflammatory marker levels, these compounds effectively ameliorated the inflammatory response. Additionally, they decreased APAP induced levels of apoptosis-signal-regulating kinase-1 (ASK-1) and c-Jun-N-terminal kinase (JNK1). Additionally, they reduced caspase-3 and BCL2-associated X-protein (Bax) levels and promoted Nrf2 signaling pathway activation. Notably, the in-silico computer-assisted simulation docking results were consistent with the experimental measurements.
abstract_zh: 肝纤维化是一个重要的公共卫生问题，迫切需要持续寻求高效的新型治疗方法。基于我们团队在先前对他克林衍生物研究中取得的令人鼓舞的成果，本研究使用了我们新合成的稠合吖嗪衍生物化合物（1a、1b、2a 和 2b）。本研究考察了这些化合物对对乙酰氨基酚（APAP）诱导的肝纤维化小鼠的保肝作用，并阐明了其可能的作用机制。给予这些化合物通过降低血清肝酶水平以及减轻肝脏病理恶化，成功减轻了APAP诱导的肝纤维化。此外，它们增加了肝脏抗氧化剂水平，并抵御了APAP引起的氧化应激。进一步地，通过降低炎症细胞因子水平并提高抗炎标志物水平，这些化合物有效改善了炎症反应。此外，它们降低了APAP诱导的凋亡信号调节激酶-1（ASK-1）和c-Jun N末端激酶（JNK1）水平。同时，它们降低了caspase-3和BCL2相关X蛋白（Bax）水平，并促进了Nrf2信号通路的激活。值得注意的是，计算机辅助模拟对接结果与实验测量结果一致。
